meeting_scene: The team meeting began with Priya standing up to share her thoughts on last week's project milestone, beaming a 95% morale boost onto herself as she effortlessly explained how it was "a huge success". As others nodded in agreement, Alex couldn't help but slip into their quiet confidence zone, taking over the discussion for Vikram who seemed engrossed by something internal. Meanwhile Jordan shifted uncomfortably on his seat with a stress reading that remained steady despite Priya's motivational talk about teamwork and recognition at deadlines; Sam spoke up after him quietly concernedly expressing how some of these recent successes still weighed heavily upon them, as their current high didn't compensate for all the worries they carried around outside.
